User_Question: I cannot sign in to my Xbox account
Reply: Which issue are you facing: changed password, forgot password, forgot email/phone, error message, or Xbox network sign-in problem?

User_Question: I forgot my Microsoft account password. How can I reset it?
Reply: Go to Reset your password, enter your Microsoft account email, verify your identity with a security code, and then create a new password

User_Question: Why was I charged twice for my Xbox subscription?
Reply: You may see what looks like a double charge if a renewal, a retried past-due payment, multiple purchases grouped as one, or another active XBOX subscription on a different account were all billed around the same time.

User_Question: How do I request a refund for a game I purchased?
Reply: Sign in to the purchasing account, open purchase history, select the game, and submit a refund request with your reason.

User_Question: My Game Pass subscription is not working
Reply: Check that your Xbox Game Pass is active, the game is still available, your device meets its requirements, and Xbox services are online.

User_Question: My Xbox controller will not connect to the console
Reply: Power cycle your console, test the controller via USB, then re-sync it wirelessly if it works.

User_Question: The buttons on my controller are not responding
Reply: Check the game’s controller settings, then review or reset your button mapping in Settings, and test the buttons in the XBOX Accessories app.

User_Question: My Xbox keeps disconnecting from Wi-Fi
Reply: Power cycle your Xbox and router, move the console closer to the router, and reduce Wi-Fi interference from walls or metal objects.

User_Question: I cannot play multiplayer games online
Reply: Check that your subscription is active, the game needs no extra content, and test your connection and NAT type under Settings

User_Question: My Xbox console will not turn on
Reply: Unplug the Xbox for 10 seconds, reconnect it, press the Xbox button, and check the outlet and cables if it still won’t turn on.

User_Question: My console turns off while I am playing
Reply: This usually means overheating, power, or auto-shutdown settings—cool the console, ensure good ventilation, and check Settings

User_Question: Why is my game download stuck?
Reply: Check Xbox service status, available storage, and the download queue in My games & apps to ensure the install isn’t paused.

User_Question: I cannot install a game on my Xbox
Reply: Check Xbox service status, sign in, ensure enough storage and system updates, then resume or restart the install from My games & apps

User_Question: My game crashes every time I open it.
Reply: Check for XBOX service issues, then exit and restart the game, power cycle your console, and verify your network connection if it still crashes.

User_Question: I receive an error when trying to start my game
Reply: Finish all updates, restart the game, and power cycle the console if needed.

User_Question: My Xbox is running very slowly
Reply: Run Settings > General > Network settings > Test network connection and Test network speed & statistics to check for network issues.

User_Question: I cannot access my purchased games
Reply: Sign in with the purchasing account and check your order history to confirm the games weren’t refunded or canceled and you still have the license.

User_Question: How can I change my Xbox account email address?
Reply: Go to account.microsoft.com > Your info > Manage how you sign in, add an email alias, and set it as your primary sign-in address.

User_Question: I think someone has hacked my Xbox account
Reply: Reset your Microsoft account password immediately and follow the compromised account steps to secure your info and lock out any attacker.

User_Question: I was charged for something I did not purchase
Reply: Sign in to your Microsoft account, check Xbox purchase history for the charge, and submit a refund request if it’s unauthorized.
